items.title: A non-Jacobson Kolmogorov space with a basis of quasi-compact opens has a locally closed non-closed point
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a Kolmogorov space with a basis of quasi-compact opens which is not Jacobson possesses a non-closed point whose singleton is locally closed (author lemma at source lines 3569-3575, label lemma-non-jacobson-Noetherian-characterize). The proof (source lines 3577-3586) translates non-Jacobsonness into the existence of a closed set and an open set meeting it without closed points, shrinks the open set using the basis and applies the closed point statement inside the intersection (proof lines 3577-3585). The translation and the shrink are the content. H3.
